description: List services WhatsDownNow monitors (slug, name, category). Optional filters: query (a name like 'openai' or 'google cloud'; returns the best matches) and category (AI, Developer & Cloud, Work & Productivity, Google, Microsoft, Apple, Social & Streaming, Money & Shopping, Gaming, Home & Security, Banks & Investing, Internet & Phone, Travel & Delivery). You rarely need this before create_alert_stack, which accepts common names directly.

category.description: Only list services in this category

query.description: Service name to look up, e.g. 'OpenAI', 'Cloudflare', 'Chase'

name: list_services
title: List monitored services
